transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI's new safety system could have detected the Hugging Face breach 30 hours earlier, flagging it in 15 minutes, reported by Inshorts.
Mistral Large 4 released with ownership rights, outperforming Claude Fable 5.1 on benchmarks and offering lower token costs, reported by OrcaRouter.
Google's Gemini 4 Carbon outperforms rivals in cybersecurity with 0 percent prompt injection success, reported by PCMag Middle East.
SkyRL boosts Mistral Large 4's AIME score 11 points on 8 GB200 nodes via LoRA RL, reported by OrcaRouter.
Trust3 AI adds artificial intelligence agent visibility to Claude Code without software installs, reported by Cyprus Shipping News.
